notes: Could not locate an official, independently-documented "Paygent Connect" product. Multiple unrelated entities share the "Paygent" name (Japanese Paygent Co./GMO-affiliated payment gateway at pay-gent.com with no public dev docs found; api.paygent.tech, an unrelated crypto/AI-agent wallet product; and generic "paygent" WooCommerce/gomerchant integrations for the Japanese gateway). The hint "NMI-powered" suggests Paygent Connect is a small white-label/ISV reseller built on NMI's gateway platform (common for ISOs), which would mean the underlying tech is NMI's Direct Post/Query REST API (api_key-style security-key auth) but issued under Paygent's own branding after merchant underwriting — a pattern typical of NMI resellers, not self-serve. The paygent.com domain returned no response (status 0) in the deterministic probe and no docs page was found. All fields above are best-effort inference from the NMI white-label reseller pattern, not verified against an actual Paygent Connect developer portal — confidence is low and this should be re-verified with a live fetch of the actual Paygent Connect vendor domain if/when it is identified. MCP registry hits ("com.obsmetrics.paygent/agents", "io.github.djautomd-lab/aipaygent") could not be confirmed as related to this specific product, so mcp.status is reported as unknown rather than guessed.
